First, note that time zones as we know them did not exist in 1639.  
But if we apply modern time zone rules retroactively:  
US/Mountain = UTC-7 (standard time, no DST in December).  
Asia/Tokyo = UTC+9.  
Time difference = 9 - (-7) = 16 hours ahead.  

7 AM Mountain + 16 hours = 23:00 (11 PM) same day.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1639-12-03 23:00
